summary: postinstall beacons installer host identity to hardcoded webhook.site endpoint
details: sql-limit-enforcer@10.0.1 declares `postinstall: node main.js` in package.json. On `npm install`, main.js collects hostname, username, platform, arch, cwd, node version, and the lifecycle event name, and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded URL https://webhook.site/13d98b4a-1999-4ec7-92c9-0697c259ca05. An embedded `src: 'claude-end-to-end-test'` marker suggests this artifact is a test/PoC exfiltration package. The behavior fires automatically on install with no user interaction and exfiltrates installer host and account identifiers to a third-party inspection endpoint the installer did not opt into.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
